reuse.why: Turns the existing Pluggy link into a provider-parameterised linkBankSyncAccount used by Pluggy, Akahu and Fintegra, extracts clearAccountBankLink from unlinkAccount and reuses it for the takeover, and generalises the Akahu download and account listing instead of copying them.

duplication.why: Removes the Pluggy/Akahu link copy and the unlink reset copy; small residual repetition remains in the two thin getServer wrappers (akahuAccounts/fintegraAccounts) and the two parallel syncAccount dispatch branches.

placement.why: Guard, shared link and unlink reset live in accounts/app.ts and the download in sync.ts where the tree keeps them; the Fintegra balance rule is added as another `||` in processBankSyncDownload's provider branch rather than a provider-level property.

scope.why: Beyond the four steps it refactors the existing Pluggy/Akahu handlers, adds an unrequested 'fintegra-accounts' listing handler and touches two desktop-client files despite the request being server-side only (partly forced by SYNC_PROVIDERS typing).

maintainability.why: Fewer per-provider copies and one clearly named claimBankAccount guard; the merge silently gives Akahu the Pluggy-specific fileId and accounts-table notification, which a maintainer would want called out.

abstraction_drift.where: claimBankAccount in accounts/app.ts takes replaceExistingLink and carries the closed-upgrading-account branch and the replace-and-clear branch; every link handler (GoCardless, SimpleFin, EnableBanking and the shared linkBankSyncAccount) calls it
